items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: when the bands would come from New Orleans, like Papa Celestin, Don Albert, King Oliver, and other bands from Chicago

ctx.x: Yes, I would love to know about getting a visit — you said King Oliver presented your—

Okay, well like I said, during those days, when the bands would come from New Orleans, like Papa Celestin, Don Albert, King Oliver, and other bands from Chicago, see bands that was based in Chicago, they all came from New Orleans, see? But that was their home town. And people would say, “Hey, let the kid play something — why don’t you let the kid play something?” And even during those days you sang, and this was before microphones or anything, this was during the days when we used to sing Rudy Vallee with a…
